qa_pairs.question: What is the recommended approach for optimizing resource usage and job performance for Ansys Mechanical APDL simulations on Alliance clusters?
qa_pairs.answer: Users should conduct scaling tests before running production jobs to identify the optimal number of cores and the minimum memory required. Additionally, single-node (SMP shared memory parallel) scripts are generally preferred over multi-node (DIS distributed memory parallel) scripts, as they typically offer better performance.

qa_pairs.question: Why should the Ansys module version loaded in a script match the version used to create the input file for Mechanical APDL jobs on Alliance clusters?
qa_pairs.answer: To help prevent compatibility issues, the Ansys module version loaded in a script should ideally be the same as the version of Ansys used to generate the input file.
